name: folded-r
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished, very minimal logo concept presentation for a desktop/browser resume reformatting tool called ReCV. The app preserves professional experience while reorganizing and rewriting a resume into a client's fixed template. This is brand exploration, not a finished app screenshot. Square white presentation sheet, ample whitespace, exact crisp flat vector-like geometry, no texture, no shadows, no gradients, no mockup objects. Near the upper middle show a large distinctive symbol followed by the exact wordmark "ReCV" (capital R, lowercase e, capital C and V), clean medium-weight humanist sans-serif, carefully spaced. In the lower third show exactly three compact applications of THE SAME symbol: dark ink on white, white in a forest-green rounded square app icon, and a small simple dark favicon-sized mark. Black/near-black and the muted forest green already used by the app interface, restrained and functional. A tiny concept number in the top left. No slogans, no extra headings, no other words. Use few bold shapes with open counters; must remain legible at 24 px. Avoid robots, sparkles, people silhouettes, brain icons, ornamental details, generic stock-logo swooshes, hairlines. All examples must use one consistent symbol, not variations within this sheet.
Concept 01: a custom solid geometric R monogram derived from the silhouette of a single upright document. Use a clever, simple negative-space cut for its bowl and a clear diagonal leg. A single clipped upper corner can quietly suggest a paper fold. Prioritize the readable R and distinctive compact silhouette over a literal document drawing. Do not draw text lines inside it. Small label "01".
